title: sum_squares calls square twice
note: Real compiler output, generated on the Ascend build machine and committed unchanged. -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables only removes .cfi lines; -fno-pie/-no-pie keep addresses simple. At -O2 gcc inlines square into sum_squares and computes main's sum_squares(3, 4) = 25 at compile time; Ubuntu's gcc also turns printf into the checked __printf_chk.
